messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 13(1)

Article 13 Procedure for partly completed machinery. 1. The manufacturer of partly completed machinery or his authorised representative shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that: (a) the relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B is prepared; (b) assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared; (c) a declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B has been drawn up.

response.text:
Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative | shall ensure that technical documentation is prepared | relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B | before placing the machinery on the market | "shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that: (a) the relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B is prepared"
Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative | shall ensure that assembly instructions are prepared | assembly instructions described in Annex VI | before placing the machinery on the market | "(b) assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared"
Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative | shall ensure that a declaration is drawn up | declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B | before placing the machinery on the market | "(c) a declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B has been drawn up"
